newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit retains overnight losses on weak regionals.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit retains overnight losses on weak regionals.

text.p: The ringgit remained under pressure on Tuesday morning after overnight losses caused by a fresh selling of Southeast Asian currencies, dealers said.
They said volumes remained thin and spreads wide, which was exaggerating movements.
"Thai baht is still seen weak and the rupiah is also under sustained attack," said a European bank dealer in Singapore.
He said wide spread of 50 points between bids and offers was keeping some of the speculative demand also at bay, but ringgit remained under pressure in the near-term.
Dealers said some exporters' dollar selling around 2.80 level was slowing the ringgit's fall.
"Even a few (million) dollars can move dollar/ringgit 100 points," said a dealer with a Malaysian bank.
At 0230 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.7900/50 to a dollar.
